record_title: Fourier-partial breakdown and support-deflated tubal Arnoldi
provenance: Analysis of partial Fourier-slice breakdown in t-product tubal Arnoldi, with an idempotent-support continuation and tensor-function consequence grounded in the normalization and breakdown definitions of the cited tensor-Krylov literature.
limitations: The main theorem is exact-arithmetic; the positive-tolerance example does not supply a backward-stable locking threshold. The support-deflated frame is projective rather than unit-tubal orthonormal, the module proof is stated over complex tubal scalars, and block/tubal-global variants are not analyzed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
